text:
Maya: Quick plan check — we need a compact welcome email + webinar invite for new signups next Tue. Goals: onboard, nudge product try, and register for webinar.

Jon: Id keep segments minimal: trial-start (0-48h), api-trials (used API), and partners/pilot.

Serena: Subject ideas (value vs curiosity):
- Value: "Start fast: 3 quick wins with Redwood"
- Curiosity: "Why infra teams cut inference cost by 4x"

Alex K: Send windows by region, keep bursts low. Draft: PST 10:30 / EST 11:30 / CET 14:00 / APAC local 09:30. Retry +48h for non-openers w/ alt subject.

Noah: Add UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=welcome_q2 and hidden ?onboard=welcome. Events: newsletter.sent, newsletter.open, newsletter.click, webinar.signup.

Maya: Lightweight drip or one-off + reminder?

Jon: Recommend 3-touch drip: Day0 welcome+webinar CTA, Day3 product case study + CTA, Day7 webinar reminder + calendar link. Webinar = funnel anchor.

Serena: A/B plan: Day0 split subjects 50/50; Day3 CTA copy test ("Reserve your spot" vs "Save my seat"). Keep cohorts balanced.

Alex K: Suppress current customers and orgs with >5 active tokens. Dedupe if someone already visited webinar page. Include unsubscribe & prefs link.

CampaignBot: [automated] Campaign created: welcome_q2. Preview: https://tiny.redwood/welcome-preview

Noah: ESP caps: daily 50k, per-minute burst <1200. Configure hard-bounce suppression and retry SMTP backoff.

Maya: Assignments: @Serena subjects + copy variants, @Alex K send rules + suppression, @Noah tracking + events, @Jon landing + calendar widget. I'll draft the final playbook by EOD.

Jon: Will post landing draft shortly.

Serena: Dropping 6 subject variants in sheet now.

Alex K: Adding send window rules to config doc and setting retry logic.

Maya: If anyone sees risky overlap with other sends tomorrow, ping me here. :eyes:
